lines.t: As the shadows fall and the night closes in
As the light fades and it feels like the end
When it feels like all the love is gone and I can't seem to see beyond
When everything is overwhelming and evil's all anyone's telling
You show up and your love is a light
Drawing away the shadows, leading away the night
When I can't get the darkness away
You come and turn the night into day
Yahushua
You protect me
From the darkness of the night
You put away the shadows
You're my light, your love is a lantern, your kindness my shield, your grace my armor, your word's the sword I wield.
And I will never fear, because you're who you are, you're always near.
Lord, you are my shield.
When I'm struck down, you lift me up When they speak only darkness, you speak light
And when they try to do me harm, you're there to protect me
You are my shield, and I will always believe in you, Lord
Lord, my shepherd, my shelter, my bridegroom, my friend,
you protect me until the end.
Yahushua, you protect me
From the darkness of the night
You put away the shadows, you're my light
Your love is a lantern, your kindness my shield
Your grace my armor, your words the sword I wield
And I will never fear, because you're sure
You're always near
Lord, you are my shield
You lift me high above the clouds
In your arms I'll never doubt
And as long as I'm here
When evil draws near
You'll be my shield
With every step I take, you're the choice I make
Even when they push me around, when they're trying to strike me down
Your words are the sword I wield
And you will always be
Oh Lord, you're my shield
You'll protect me
Thank you.
